about_the_game:
Your favorite fisherman Sime Returns, but the celebration is short...

When Sime sails back to his island with a boat full of free fish, the villagers cheer, music plays, and his loyal cats follow him home. For a day, the island is alive with joy.

But by the next morning, the fish are gone. The cats reveal a bitter truth: the villagers never loved Sime they only loved his free fish.

Sime refuses to keep providing free fish, and the once smiling villagers turn hostile. They beat him, steal what’s left of his catch, and imprison his beloved cats across the island.

Armed with nothing but a slappy fish, Sime sets out to save his cat friends and uncover the island’s darkest secrets.

What begins as a cheerful, quirky homecoming spirals into a surreal and emotional odyssey, one that will take him from sunny Adriatic shores to the mysterious, drowned ruins of Atlantis.

A Story That Matters – Themes of identity, betrayal, and resilience told through humor, melancholy, and heartfelt moments.

Tone That Shifts With You – Watch the island change from bright and celebratory to dark and surreal as Sime’s world unravels.

Betrayal at the Core – Experience Sime’s emotional journey from beloved fisherman to hunted outcast, fighting to reclaim his dignity.

Save What Matters Most – Free your cats from imprisonment across the island and piece together what happened to your home.

Fish Slapping Combat – Use fish as your primary weapon to fend off villagers and overcome strange obstacles.

Dynamic Action Sequences – Escape ambushes, survive chase scenes, solve environmental puzzles under pressure, and face creative boss fights that blend humor and tension.

Explore & Uncover – Navigate fishing docks, twisted villages, haunted graveyards, and even the lost city of Atlantis.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of fantasy violence and dark themes. Players will encounter undead creatures, underwater predators, and combat sequences involving melee weapons, magic, and occasional firearm use. No explicit nudity, drug use, or sexual content is depicted.

short_description: Sime Returns, a whimsical yet dark action-adventure about a fisherman, his cats, and an island that turned against him. Rescue your cats, fight back with a slappy fish, and uncover the dark secrets hidden beneath the Adriatic waves. Surreal tale of cats, betrayal, fish swinging combat and much more.
